Retrieve all compound entries (including their public identifiers, names, and related document details) that are explicitly associated with the document CHEMBL5729258.  For each qualifying compound, return:

- The public ChEMBL identifier (from `compound_dictionary.chembl_id`).
- The compound’s preferred name (from `compound_dictionary.pref_name`).
- The document’s identifier (from `docs.chembl_id`).
- The document’s title (from `docs.title`).
- The document’s publication year (from `docs.year`).

A compound is linked to the document when it appears as the target of any activity (i.e., there is a row in `activities` whose `doc_id` points to `docs.doc_id` equal to `CHEMBL5729258`).  The result set may contain multiple rows per compound (one per distinct activity or document link).  No filtering on activity type, units, dose, or any other activity column is required; simply return all compounds reported in the specified document.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS compound_name,
  d.chembl_id AS document_chembl_id,
  d.title AS document_title,
  d.year AS document_year
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.chembl_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729258'
ORDER BY md.pref_name, d.title
